ai.title: Add prompt debug logging to backend main-prompt.ts
ai.summary: Added fs and path imports to backend/src/main-prompt.ts. New logic calculates character counts for messages, system, and tools, then appends JSON to prompt.debug.json via fs.appendFileSync. Internal change scoped to backend prompt handling. Debug file writes to __dirname on every prompt invocation.

eli5.text: Every time the assistant generates a reply, the system now writes the size (in characters) of each part of the prompt to a small text file called prompt.debug.json in the backend folder. This only runs on the server and is purely for developers to inspect later, so you as a reader won't see any difference in how the assistant behaves or responds.

ai.title: Fix CLI prompt duplication and input queueing
ai.summary: CLI prompt logic moved from constructor to `printInitialPrompt` and called after `handleUserInput` completes. Input lines are now ignored if `isReceivingResponse` is true, preventing race conditions. `index.ts` calls `printInitialPrompt` only when no user prompt is provided, removing duplicate initial output. `musings.knowledge.md` marks bash execution notes as complete.

eli5.text: When you open the tool, it no longer shows the same opening line twice, and it won't accidentally process a line you typed while it's still working on a previous request. The fix matters if you've seen the menu prompt appear twice or noticed your keystrokes get mixed up with an in-progress answer; starting today, the program only prints the welcome line once and skips any typing that arrives while it's still answering.

ai.title: Bump manicode npm version to 1.0.20
ai.summary: Version increment in npm-app/package.json from 1.0.19 to 1.0.20. Standard release housekeeping for the CLI package. No functional code changes.

eli5.text: The program you download for your computer quietly got a new number (like a new edition sticker on a catalog item) so that installation tools know it's the latest version. This change only updates that number in the program's paperwork and does not add new features or fix problems you would see. You would only notice if you checked that number yourself.

ai.title: Improve prompt debug log
ai.summary: Refactors prompt debugging in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to append structured JSON arrays to `prompt.debug.json` instead of appending raw objects. Introduces `savePromptLengthInfo` to capture message content, system/tools lengths, and timestamps. Updates `npm-app/package.json` formatting.

eli5.text: The way the assistant records what it sends to the AI in the background has been tidied up so that information is saved in a neat, consistent list rather than jumbled notes, making it easier for developers to review when things go wrong. This only affects the internal tooling developers use to investigate issues and does not change anything you notice while using the assistant today.

ai.title: backend/deploy.sh: update-container replaces delete-recreate
ai.summary: backend/deploy.sh now calls gcloud compute instances update-container when the VM exists, instead of deleting and recreating it. This preserves instance state and avoids full provisioning on every deploy. New VMs still use create-with-container with identical flags. Scope limited to backend deploy script.

eli5.text: When you deploy updates to your private backend server, it now quietly swaps in the new version without tearing down and rebuilding the whole machine, so the server's current state and settings stay put between deployments. This only affects the behind-the-scenes process that pushes new code to Google's hosting for your backend, so you won't see a different experience unless you're actively deploying, and even then the only noticeable thing is that deploying finishes without the usual full setup delay.

ai.title: Update .gitignore entries
ai.summary: Removed debug.log and tsconfig.tsbuildinfo from root .gitignore; added prompt.debug.json and debug.log to backend/.gitignore. Refines ignored file patterns for backend debugging artifacts.

eli5.text: The project cleaned up which temporary files get hidden from the shared code folder. Files named debug.log and a build cache file were removed from the main ignore list, while debug.log and prompt.debug.json were added specifically to the backend folder's ignore list. If you use the code, you won't see these temporary debugging files cluttering your backend folder, but the main project folder may now show some files that were previously hidden. This housekeeping only affects developers working directly in the code.
